description: Fetch a normalized catalog metadata projection for a Smithsonian object by its record_id (from smithsonian_search_objects results). Returns title, dates, description, labeled notes, makers, materials, dimensions, places, cultures, topics, exhibition history, current display (on_view and current_exhibitions, for objects the catalog flags), credit line, identifiers, rights, and a media summary. indexed carries the exact name, place, object_type, date, and topic values the record is indexed under, each passable verbatim to the smithsonian_search_objects filter of the same name — the free-text makers, places, dates, and topics often differ from them. Natural-history records can include scientific_names, taxonomy, and collection coordinates without inferred precision. The media summary counts the media and links every non-image item (3D models, scanned books, documents); full image URLs come from smithsonian_get_media.
name: smithsonian_get_object

coordinates.description: Collection points without inferred precision or geocoding; empty when no valid decimal pairs exist.

items.description: A valid reported decimal coordinate pair.

current_exhibitions.description: Where the object is on display now, from the catalog; [] when it names none.

items.description: One place the object is on display; absent parts are omitted.

building.description: Building code where the object is shown ("NASM", "HAZY", "NPG", "NMAI NY") — not a unit_code.

room.description: Gallery or room within the building.

title.description: Title of the exhibition showing it.

dates.description: All date fields in the catalog record.

description.description: Best available prose description from Summary, Physical Description, Brief Description, Description, Description (Brief), or Citation notes. Absent when only administrative notes exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No object with the given ID exists in the Smithsonian catalog. `invalid_id`: The ID format is clearly malformed (empty string, whitespace only). `api_key_rejected`: The Smithsonian API refused this server's SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY (an api.data.gov API_KEY_* error). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhibitions.description: Free-text exhibition history, which the catalog rarely fills: [] does not mean the object was never exhibited. on_view and current_exhibitions report current display.

building.description: Building or venue where the exhibition was held.

holding_museum_name.description: The unit that holds the object, from the record's own data source, when it differs from the unit that indexes it (unit_code). Absent otherwise.

indexed.description: The record's indexed values for five smithsonian_search_objects filters, in catalog order, each passable verbatim as that filter's value to find objects sharing it. An empty array means the record indexes nothing for that filter. culture, scientific_names, and unit_code already carry indexed values.

date.description: Indexed date terms ("1860s") — each a filters.date value. dates[] is the free-text form ("ca. 1850").

name.description: Indexed named parties, surname-first ("Armstrong, Neil A.") — each a smithsonian_search_objects filters.name value as written. makers[] is the free-text form of the same parties and often differs.

object_type.description: Indexed object type terms ("Quilts") — each a filters.object_type value.

place.description: Indexed place terms ("Virginia", "United States") — each a filters.place value as written. place[] is the free-text form.

topic.description: Indexed topic terms ("Quilts") — each a filters.topic value as written.

is_cc0.description: True when the object metadata is CC0 (open access). The Smithsonian Open Access corpus is CC0 throughout, so this flag rarely varies — read media_summary.has_cc0_images to predict whether smithsonian_get_media returns images.

makers.description: All named parties associated with this object.

items.description: A material or physical description string.

media_summary.description: Media availability summary, with a link to each non-image item. Call smithsonian_get_media for full image URLs.

cc0_image_count.description: CC0 images on the object: the same count smithsonian_get_media reports as its cc0_image_count and pages through with start and limit. Lower than count when the object has non-image media (e.g. 3D models) or non-CC0 images.

count.description: Total number of online media items, across all types (includes non-image media such as 3D models).

has_cc0_images.description: True when at least one CC0 image is available (cc0_image_count > 0).

non_image_media.description: Every media item smithsonian_get_media does not deliver — each item typed as something other than Images — in catalog order. Empty when there are none.

is_cc0.description: True when this item is CC0 open access.

type.description: Upstream media type, e.g. "3d_voyager", "Scanned books", "slideshowXML", "Electronic resource".

url.description: The item's link — a 3D viewer, a scanned book, a document viewer, or a PDF. Absent when the catalog gives none.

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail URL (~150px) of the first media item.

mirror_snapshot.description: Publication time (ISO 8601) of the Open Access snapshot the mirror held; what came from oa_mirror reflects the catalog as of then. Present when part of this answer came from oa_mirror.

museum_name.description: Full museum name. A few rarely-indexed archive sub-unit codes have no mapped name and fall back to the raw unit code.

notes.description: All nonempty catalog notes in source order, including repeated labels.

label.description: Catalog note label, or Note when absent.

on_view.description: True when the catalog flags the object as on physical display now, false when it flags it as not. Absent when the record carries no flag, which most do — absence says nothing about display. smithsonian_search_objects filters.on_view_only finds the flagged objects.

record_link.description: Canonical Smithsonian Institution URL for this object.

scientific_names.description: All reported scientific names in source order; no accepted-name inference.

sources.description: Where this answer came from. A page served from oa_mirror lists its rows in mirror order, not the live API's, and its notice names the snapshot date. Present only on a server that keeps a mirror.

items.description: oa_mirror: the server's local copy of the Smithsonian Open Access bulk metadata. edan_api: the live Smithsonian API.

taxonomy.description: Reported taxonomic ranks; absent ranks remain omitted.

topics.description: Subject and topic terms: the indexed topic terms merged with the free-text subject strings of the catalog ("Quilts--History"), so not every entry is a topic filter value — take those from indexed.topic.

unit_code.description: Museum unit code the object is indexed under — the value a unit_code filter matches.

title: Get Smithsonian Object
